message: The 'talking points' you're so fond of dismissing in others are the only ones you're familiar with, and you can't even be bothered to come up with something original. It's laughable. And let's be real, you're not here to discuss the war on drugs or even to make a coherent argument – you're here to virtue-signal to your buddies. Well, let me tell you, it's not working. You're not fooling anyone with your posturing, and you certainly don't deserve to be taken seriously in this discussion.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent's arguments 'laughable' and accuses them of 'virtue-signaling' and 'posturing' rather than engaging with their ideas.  The message dismisses the opponent's sincerity and motives.
